title: Our Job is Obedience
verse: And Noah did all that God commanded him—he did indeed.
observation: I cannot imagine how difficult it would be to even begin to understand the task given to Noah. He is supposed to build a massive boat that will basically be a life raft to save humanity and the animals God created. How do you even begin to start attacking this job? Noah realized the only thing to do was to do what God said. He did not decide to figure it out on his own. He did everything the Lord said. In our lives, we will come across issues that are bigger than us and seem impossible. Our job is not to try and outthink God or figure it out by ourselves. Our job is to figure out what would be most honoring to the Lord and then do that. God will take our best effort and do something amazing.
application: What is the most God-honoring way you can fulfill your commitments and live your life today? Do that.
prayer: Thank You, Jesus, for helping us take every single step.
